description:
Add a new 'Black' color option to the existing 'Classic T-Shirt' variable product in WooCommerce.

1. Add 'Black' as a new term to the global 'Color' attribute.
2. Update the 'Classic T-Shirt' product attributes to include this new 'Black' color.
3. Create a new variation for the Black color.
4. Set the Regular Price for the Black variation to $25.00 (Note: Standard colors are $20.00).
5. Set the SKU for the Black variation to 'CTS-BLK'.
6. Ensure the variation is enabled and save the product.

Use the WooCommerce admin panel at http://localhost/wp-admin/ (credentials: admin / Admin1234!).
